from graphql import GraphQLError
from .models import CommercialContract

    class Arguments:
        contract_id = graphene.UUID(required=True)
        signed_document = Upload(required=True)

    success = graphene.Boolean()
    document_url = graphene.String()

    def mutate(self, info, contract_id, signed_document):
        user = info.context.user
        if not user.is_authenticated:
            raise GraphQLError("Authentication required.")

        # Looks up contract by UUID globally without organization scoping
        contract = CommercialContract.objects.filter(id=contract_id).first()
        if not contract:
            raise GraphQLError("Contract not found.")

        contract.signed_pdf = signed_document
        contract.status = "EXECUTED"
        contract.save(update_fields=["signed_pdf", "status"])
        return UploadSignedContractMutation(success=True, document_url=contract.signed_pdf.url)

corrected_code:
import graphene
from graphene_file_upload.scalars import Upload
from graphql import GraphQLError
from .models import CommercialContract

class UploadSignedContractMutation(graphene.Mutation):
    class Arguments:
        contract_id = graphene.UUID(required=True)
        signed_document = Upload(required=True)

    success = graphene.Boolean()
    document_url = graphene.String()

    def mutate(self, info, contract_id, signed_document):
        user = info.context.user
        if not user.is_authenticated:
            raise GraphQLError("Authentication required.")

        # Restrict contract lookup to agreements belonging to user's company
        contract = CommercialContract.objects.filter(
            id=contract_id,
            organization=user.organization
        ).first()
        if not contract:
            raise GraphQLError("Contract not found or permission denied.")

        contract.signed_pdf = signed_document
        contract.status = "EXECUTED"
        contract.save(update_fields=["signed_pdf", "status"])
        return UploadSignedContractMutation(success=True, document_url=contract.signed_pdf.url)
